description:
# LSC-02 | Main | Hourly Luma Guests → SF Campaign Members

**📋 Ticket:** [Luma guests → Salesforce campaign members](https://brightdata-group.monday.com/boards/8667788707/pulses/13343839880)

---

**TRIGGER:** Scheduler — every hour, Asia/Jerusalem

**PURPOSE:** Sync queued Luma guests to Salesforce campaign members 1h after registration, retrying at 3h.

**FLOW:**
1. Get Pending rows with `next_attempt_at` ≤ now → PostgreSQL
2. For each: call Fun 002 → write Done / Skipped / Not found / Error + SF IDs back to the row
3. Not found / Campaign not found on 1st attempt → stay Pending, retry in 2h; on 2nd → final status
4. New Not found / Campaign not found rows → Slack field marketing (email, SF campaign, member status, reason)
5. If new Error rows exist → mark notified and stop with error (→ System Error Handling)

**DB / TABLES:** `marketing.luma_sf_campaign_queue` (read/write)
**UPSTREAM:** LSC-01 | Fun 001 | Queue Luma Guest for SF Campaign Sync (fills the queue)  
**DOWNSTREAM:** LSC-02 | Fun 002 | Sync Luma Guest to SF Campaign

## Important logic
- Attempts: +1h (Fun 001) and +3h (retry). Each Not found / Campaign not found / Error row alerts once.
- Slack channel: Marketing project property `lsc_field_marketing_channel`.
- Max 500 rows per run; the rest are picked up next hour.
